featured_reviews.name: ADITYA SALVI
featured_reviews.review_text:
Naturals Ice Cream Outlet – A Sweet Spot for Ice Cream Lovers

Naturals is always a reliable place when you're craving a scoop of real, flavorful ice cream. The outlet has a pleasant, clean vibe – nothing fancy, but definitely a good place to sit back and enjoy a cold treat.

Their ice creams are known for being made with natural ingredients, and you can really taste the difference. My all-time favorite is the Tender Coconut – it's light, refreshing, and perfectly captures the essence of the fruit. If you haven’t tried it yet, it’s a must.

I also gave the Mango a shot this time – decent, but it didn’t quite hit the same level. Still, with so many seasonal and classic options on their menu, there's always something worth trying.

Overall, Naturals remains a solid go-to for ice cream that tastes close to homemade.

About pricing — we use top-notch ingredients and generous portions (and yes, a lot of love), which reflects in the cost… but hey, we’ll keep working on making the experience feel as premium as the desserts taste 💯

featured_reviews.review_text:
Let me start straight — the attitude at this place is ruining what could otherwise be a great shop.
I’ve been visiting since childhood. Back when the father used to sit at the counter, there was warmth, humility, and genuine respect for customers. That’s how this place built its reputation.
Now? Completely different story.
The son who currently handles the counter is shockingly rude, ill-mannered, and arrogant. He doesn’t properly explain the menu and often seems like he doesn’t even know it well himself.
Let’s be clear — the ice cream still tastes great. I’ve always loved the flavors, and quality-wise, it’s still solid.

featured_reviews.name: Rohit Mandavkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Natural Ice Cream and had a fantastic experience. The flavors are incredibly fresh and taste just like the real fruit – I tried the Tender Coconut and Alphonso Mango, and both were absolutely divine. You can really tell they use natural ingredients with no artificial aftertaste.

The outlet was clean, well-lit, and had a calm, welcoming vibe. The staff was polite and helpful, and service was quick even though the place was moderately busy. Prices are a bit on the premium side, but honestly, the quality justifies it.

I also appreciated that they allow you to taste a flavor before buying—great for indecisive folks like me!

Highly recommend this place if you want authentic, fruit-based ice cream that’s both refreshing and indulgent.

featured_reviews.name: Jyot Antani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Its commendable that the owner of Naturals, is a fruit vendor's son! Like a normal fruit seller! What an ammmmazing brand story it is!

Huge respect for Shri Raghunandan Srinivas Kamathji🙏🏻

Naturals, is a go to place for my family.
You can rely on these that there will be no harmful ingredients. Like they say... Milk, sugar and fruits. Thats it!
They have 2 cup sizes. ( picture included)
Single scoop- 65rs
Double scoop- 120/- (10rs less than 2 single scoop) you can choose 2 different flavours. So if you are a group of friends, go for this option! 🤩

I love all the in-store posters and collaterals.. Very nicely scripted and designed❤

Here are Must trys:
-Tender Coconut (the malai that we scrape from a green coconut after sipping water..thru made ice cream with it😍)
-Coffee Walnut (not too much of coffee taste and nice crunch due to pieces of walnuts)
Check picture with waffle cone
-Roasted Almond (in my single cup picture) this one.. Is an all time favourite. There's that very different crunch and taste because of the 'roasted' almonds.
Have a look at the pictures to see, how the almond chunks are pretty nice n big!
-Jackfruit (yes.. Fanas) if you like jackfruit, then try the ice cream otherwise you must skip😅
- Sitaphal (custard apple) imagine enjoying this fruit without seeds!
If you want a sweeter taste,
Go for Anjeer, chocochip, peach apricot(smells great)
My mother loved kesarpista and not kajukismis.

Also, please check what they have as seasonal.. Look out for Berries! 🤩
Currently, 30th oct 2021, they have a nice one with Rose petals😍 found it a bit sweet for my taste but was nice.crazy

7th May 2022, PSG- PineappleStrawberryGuava this was yum(last pic in cone! (Update: Discontinued)

You can taste before you order so yes.. Go crazy!

The watermelon milkshake was so refreshing, especially on a hot day. 🍉🥤 And the orange pistachio flavor is a delightful combination of citrusy and nutty flavors. 🍊🥜 Naturals always has something exciting to offer. Enjoy! 😄👍
